CustomField.label: API Token
CustomField.description: Deprecated. Do not store new tokens here. Veleiro Setup copies the token into a protected setting and then clears this field. Kept so upgrades from 1.5.0, 1.6.0, and 1.8.0 can still read a token if that copy fails.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Deprecated. Paste the token in the Veleiro Setup tab instead. This field is cleared after the token is copied to the protected setting.
